reply: FINAL: SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, (SELECT l.ALB FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.ALB IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.Date DESC LIMIT 1) as LatestALB, CASE WHEN (SELECT l.ALB FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.ALB IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.Date DESC LIMIT 1) BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within' ELSE 'Outside' END as ALB_Status FROM Patient p WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.ALB IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.ID
